subject: English
title: Tamil Nadu State Board English, Class X

source.read: SSLC (Class X) English: prose, poem, supplementary, vocabulary, grammar and writing, as set out by the Directorate of Government Examinations and summarised by exam-guide sites
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. The official syllabus and question pattern could not be read from the build environment; this list comes from secondary summaries of the board's English paper and the class textbook. The textbook's own chapters are named by kind, not reproduced.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Gives words of the same and opposite meaning from the lessons.
Expands abbreviations and acronyms, and forms compound and blended words.
Splits words into syllables.
Uses phrasal verbs and prepositional phrases.
Uses tenses and modals.
Changes sentences between active and passive.
Changes direct speech into reported speech.
Transforms simple, compound and complex sentences.
Uses articles, conjunctions, pronouns and question tags.
Punctuates a passage and rearranges words into a sentence.
Turns a verb or adjective into its noun form in a sentence.
Reads the prose lessons and answers questions on them.
outcomes.note: Long reads practise questions on theme, character and plot on OpenPath's own stories; the board's own textbook chapters are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Reads the poems and explains their figures of speech.
outcomes.note: Poems and everyday texts asks about purpose, point of view and figurative language on OpenPath's own poems; the textbook's poems are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Reads the supplementary stories and writes about them.
outcomes.note: Long reads practise questions on theme, character and plot on OpenPath's own stories; the board's own textbook chapters are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Writes formal and informal letters and an email.
